mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate signals weakening economic conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
